title: Clinic for Tumors workers' protest during nationwide healthcare strike
reason: HRT reports 36 protesting employees at the Clinic for Tumors, below 50. About 4,000 nationwide strikers and about 200 striking at KBC Split are workforce/strike counts, not evidence of one simultaneous public gathering.
notes: Preserves the subthreshold local protest separately from the dispersed national strike.

participants_original.summary: 36 at Clinic for Tumors; larger number describes workers on strike across facilities.
